Nothing to fill in — you are basically done.

Tap the green **Create pull request** button and the checks start on their
own. They take under a minute.

Quick sanity check while you wait:

- [ ] I added **one new file**, and it is inside `contributors/`
- [ ] The file is named after my GitHub username, in small letters
- [ ] The `github:` line inside the file says exactly the same thing
- [ ] I did not change any other file

**If a check goes red**, do not panic and do not close the pull request. Tap
the red mark and read the message — it says exactly what to change. Fix it,
commit again, and the checks re-run by themselves.

Stuck? Leave a comment here. Somebody will help.
